text: Chat Ships It. Real Twitch chat in. Chat votes. Codex ships it live.
On the left, a real live Twitch channel. On the right, our slash live page, connected anonymously to Twitch I R C — no Client ID, no secrets. Real chat lines arrive and feed the vote tally.
Chat votes which feature to ship. We approve the leader, and Codex builds a sandboxed overlay widget — plan, diff, tests, then hot-load — credited to chat.
We also used Codex to build this project. Session I D zero one a one nine five nine two, documented in docs slash CODEX.md. Codex is the build tool and the game mechanic.
Try it at chat-ships-it.vercel.app slash live. Chat Ships It, by Green Robin Labs, for the Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon.
